points.description: States that cleaning is done by scraping the medium (the sand bed / Schmutzdecke layer), i.e. removal of the top layer of the filter medium by scraping.
points.partial_credit: Half only if scraping/removal of top sand is stated but without naming the medium or Schmutzdecke layer precisely.

points.description: States that the scraped medium is then washed (scraping followed by washing), with the scraped depth given as the upper 1–2 cm cut off when the Schmutzdecke becomes uncontrollable/clogged.
points.partial_credit: Half if only washing after scraping is stated, without the 1–2 cm depth or the Schmutzdecke condition.

rubric.notes: Full marks need scraping of the medium, followed by washing, with the 1–2 cm upper layer and the Schmutzdecke named. Part marks only if clearly more than half of a point is precise, e.g. scraping and washing stated but no depth or Schmutzdecke. Backwashing, chemical cleaning or other wrong methods earn nothing for the point they contradict; vague answers like "cleaned regularly" earn 0.
